description:
GetItDone is a team task and workspace manager. The GetItDone plugin lets ChatGPT work inside your workspaces directly: list the workspaces you belong to, browse and filter tasks, open a task's full details and attachments, pull the video context attached to a task, create new tasks, update existing ones, archive them, and search your workspace documentation.

You connect by signing in to your existing GetItDone account over OAuth 2.1 with PKCE. The consent screen shows exactly which scopes you grant — reading workspaces, reading tasks, and writing tasks are separate — and the assistant only ever reaches data the signed-in account can already reach. Attachment links handed to the assistant are short-lived presigned URLs rather than permanent ones. You can review and revoke any connected assistant at any time from the Connected apps tab in your GetItDone settings.

The server is tool-only over Streamable HTTP and exposes eight tools. It processes no payments, generates no images, video, or audio, and serves no ads.
